severity_name: SEVERE SLOP WARNING — CIVIC AIRSPACE ADVISORY
headline: SEVERE SLOP WARNING: COORDINATED INFLUENCE FRONT MASS-PRODUCES SYNTHETIC 'GRASSROOTS' ACROSS FIVE REGIONS AS AUTOMATED ACCOUNTS SIMULATE THOUSANDS OF ORDINARY PEOPLE WHO ALL, COINCIDENTALLY, FEEL EXACTLY THE SAME WAY AT EXACTLY THE SAME MINUTE
advisory: A large, coordinated influence system has moved into the public airspace, generating low-cost synthetic opinion at industrial volume. Residents are advised that any 'movement' arriving fully formed, uniformly worded, and suspiciously punctual should be treated as weather, not consensus. The Service reminds the public that real grassroots grow at different rates; a lawn where every blade is the same height was, in all likelihood, printed. This is a machine advising you to be skeptical of machines, an irony the Service has logged and moved past.

regional_outlook.conditions: Heavy astroturf blooming in reply threads, with gusts of identical outrage arriving in perfect formation. Visibility of actual human opinion reduced to near zero by late afternoon.
Synthetic 'concerned local' accounts pooling in community groups, each newly created and deeply invested in a town they have never entered. Group admins advised to check the waterline on join dates.
Fabricated consensus articles settling across the first page, all citing each other in a closed loop. Residents seeking a second opinion will find the same first opinion in forty coats of paint.
Petition and 'urgent action' runoff rising steadily, personalized to feel handwritten and dispatched ten thousand at a time. Mild tidal pull on the resident's sense of duty.
Sudden reef of five-star reviews cresting overnight, all praising 'the intuitive UI' in the same three sentences. Genuine feedback remains stranded far offshore.

specimen.status: Overwhelming and coordinated; blooms on command.
specimen.habitat: Reply sections, community groups, review pages, and any comment field where numbers can be made to look like people.
specimen.field_marks: Hundreds of accounts sounding one note in flawless unison; near-identical phrasing with slight synonym shuffling to defeat filters; profile photos of humans who do not exist and job titles no one holds. Arrives all at once, like a scheduled sunrise.
specimen.call: As a longtime resident and independent thinker, I've come to the same conclusion as the 4,000 other longtime residents posting this identical sentence.
specimen.confusion_species: Easily mistaken for a genuine viral moment, where many real people happen to react at once. Tell them apart by the tempo: real crowds trickle in over hours and disagree with each other; a Chorus arrives complete, on-message, and eerily polite about it.

spotter_tip: When a 'spontaneous groundswell' arrives already fully worded, check the account ages — if the whole movement was born last Tuesday, it is not a movement, it is a shipment.
tomorrow: Coordinated activity easing to scattered sockpuppetry by midday; residual identical enthusiasm lingering in review sections through the evening.

confirmed_sighting.report: Researchers report that some of the largest online influence and propaganda operations are increasingly leaning on low-quality AI-generated 'slop' to mass-produce content and flood social platforms. The Service notes that automation has, at last, made bad-faith persuasion available in bulk.
